intro: Tourism, especially diving, drives Palau's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Divers and tourists are the biggest source of income. In 2015 Palau created one of the world's largest marine sanctuaries, banning commercial fishing in most of its waters.

chapters.title: The Palau Pledge
text: Visitors must sign a pledge in their passport promising to protect the environment.
